# AI-01: AI Engineering Foundations and Model Fundamentals (Tier 1)

**Subtrack:** AI Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Tokens, sampling, context windows, model families and capabilities, async I/O and the engineering basics of AI applications.

**Tier note:** This is a foundational unit. Tier 2 has one assessment on tokenizer and sampling internals. Tier 3 is not offered because deeper model-internals work is assessed in AI-12 and ML-08.
